description: The delivered synthetic Environment evaluation library: 96 independent fixed two-night hotel scenarios across 2025–2026, with real plugin-generated request/acknowledgment/reply histories and deterministic business variation.

sources.description: All hotel, traveler, source, request, reply and event records are authored fiction. The fixed property and three-person pool implement the approved one-property/two-guest scope; dates, assignments, timing and causal histories vary independently across isolated runs. No real-data anchor is claimed or required.

generation.method: Deterministic authored variation in local dates, arrival/check-in times, observation and reply lead times, companion assignments and 2–4 causal request/acknowledgment/reply histories per run, executed through the public plugin.

transformations: All timestamps are stored as UTC instants; date coverage is counted in the property IANA timezone.
Requests, acknowledgments, final replies, source changes and companion replacements are executed through the public plugin before seed export.
Evaluation labels are stored in manifest metadata, not in public business seed records.

review.notes: Synthetic records are acceptable without a real-data anchor; independent review of causal realism and variation remains required.
